name: Tail Metaverse
technique: Logic error; Replay attack; Reward replay
classificationNote: Classified by TypeSafe jev-1.13.0 (confidence 1.00). Replaced keyword guess "signature-crypto".
rootCause: Tail Metaverse reported an approximately $88,000 exploit on BNB Chain on 2025-06-02 affecting its Tevis Mining pool staking contracts. Public incident descriptions indicate that a transferable NFT-like staking asset could be repeatedly reused to claim additional $TAILVERSE rewards after withdrawal and transfer to a new wallet, allowing the attacker to farm and sell inflated token balances. Available public reporting describes the incident as a replayable staking reward-accounting flaw in Tail Metaverse's staking contracts. The reported issue allowed the same NFT-like staking asset to become reward-eligible again after withdrawal and transfer to another wallet.…
